$comment: Coursera slugs to exclude when generating src/data/courseraCatalog.generated.ts. Because the catalog is built from a dataset snapshot, retired courses reappear on every regeneration unless they are listed here. `npm run verify:coursera` prints the slugs to add. Each entry records why, so a slug that comes back can be un-denied deliberately rather than by accident.

denied.reason: 404 as of 2026-07. Retired after the Nov 2024 snapshot; Google's R course now only ships inside the Data Analytics certificate.
